title: A rank-47 decomposition for 4x4 matrix multiplication in characteristic zero
statement: Find r<=47 and linear forms L_s,R_s on complex 4x4 matrices, with coefficient matrices P_s, such that AB=sum_{s=1}^r L_s(A)R_s(B)P_s for every pair A,B. Supply exact coefficients and verify the identity. A rational construction is a stronger coefficient restriction; a characteristic-two or border-rank construction does not meet this target.
source_locator: SRC-IMPACT-006 mathematical specification; SRC-IMPACT-007 sections 4-6; SRC-IMPACT-008 Results; SRC-IMPACT-010 Commentaries.
status_basis: The maintained problem page calls the target unsolved, the institutional catalog lists rank 48, and the October 2026 campaign reports no rank-47 construction. No matching resolution was found in a focused search; this does not establish a lower bound.
plain_summary: Can two 4x4 matrices be multiplied using 47 bilinear products instead of the 48 in current characteristic-zero constructions?
assumptions: Use the exact bilinear tensor of ordinary 4x4 matrix multiplication over C; identify a more restrictive coefficient field such as Q explicitly.
Count products of an A-linear form and a B-linear form. Additions and multiplication by fixed coefficients are not part of this rank count.
The identity must hold for all inputs. Small numerical residuals and limiting border-rank decompositions are insufficient.
scope: The fixed-size exact tensor problem. It does not ask for the general matrix-multiplication exponent or a claim of hardware speedup.
target: An explicit exact decomposition with r<=47, with a fully specified coefficient representation.
success_criteria: Provide all linear-form and output coefficients, ordering conventions and coefficient-field relations.
Verify every tensor coefficient exactly in an independent checker.
State whether the construction is rational or genuinely complex and assess practical implementation claims separately.
known_results: SRC-IMPACT-007 gives a rational 48-term construction, following the complex construction; its abstract distinguishes the 47-term characteristic-two result.
SRC-IMPACT-006 still lists the complex rank-47 target as unsolved. SRC-IMPACT-010 supplies the rank-48 baseline encodings.
SRC-IMPACT-008 reports an unsuccessful October 2026 search. Failure of that search does not exclude other decompositions.
significance: A smaller exact decomposition would improve a recognized small-size algebraic-complexity record. Its mathematical insight and practical speed need separate assessment.

requirements.theoretical_assumptions: Characteristic zero and exact arithmetic; specify the coefficient field and any quotient-polynomial relations.
